question: Dried measles vaccine must survive a week at 37 °C. Mixed with its diluent at room temperature, how soon does it lose half its potency?
answer: In about an hour. Freeze-drying holds the live virus in a dry cake; water lets it fall apart. At 20 to 25 °C the mixed vaccine loses half its potency, so it sits on ice and is discarded hours after mixing. Powder that passed a week-long heat test can spoil in one morning clinic.
move: Ask what state a thing is in before trusting its tested limits.
ask: Which limit do I trust that was tested in conditions different from mine today?
trap: Letting the powder's week of heat tolerance set the guess.
reference: World Health Organization, Temperature sensitivity of vaccines, WHO/IVB/06.10, 2006
